name: Yesan Winery
about: Yesan Winery is the English form of 예산사과와인, an agricultural company at Daemong-ro in Godeok-myeon, Yesan County, South Chungcheong. It makes apple wine and apple spirits under the Chusa name, and the county is described as Chusa's home.

A 2026 press report says it used 466 tonnes of Yesan apples that year, about 3 percent of the county's crop, and keeps barrels that held French and Spanish oak and port. Its Chusa 40 is a 40 percent apple distillate made from domestic apples and water, according to its label.
